We are a six vet, equine only veterinary practice based in South Yorkshire. This channel is designed to help our clients with routine veterinary procedures that they may need to perform at home, such as taking their horses temperature or applying a poultice. We are open to suggestions of what people would like to see and produce these videos with the aim of them being useful, so let us know what would help you.
https://www.facebook.com/EquineVeterinaryCentre
http://equineveterinarycentre.co.uk/
